                Description

                Our chunky pure wool Aran coatigan is a great alternative to a winter coat. If you like to wear fewer layers & are between sizes, go down a size for a more snug fit. With a classic cable design and handy pockets.

                Features

                100% Pure Wool

                Long-line length

                Long Sleeves

                Machine Washable (Wool Programme)

                Our Model Wears Size Small

                Tall Collar

                Aran Cable Knit Design

                Patch Pockets

                Horn buttons

                Loose Fit - Designed To Be Straighter Through The Body With Little Waist Shaping

                If you are in-between sizes, we recommend taking a size down

                Find the Perfect Fit

                Find the Perfect Fit

                Our individual garment size guides enable you to match your chosen knitwear with the best-fitting items from your current wardrobe.
                A. Bust
                Measure under your arms, across the fullest part of your bust, don't pull the measuring tape too tightly.
                B. Waist
                Measure your natural waistline (above your belly button & below your rib cage). Find by bending slightly to the side
                C. Hips
                Measure snuggly around the fullest part of your bottom. Remember to place your feet together before measuring.
